speaker: Joshua

comments.flawless: Joshua: The report was right on the first try. Bonus approved.
comments.done: Joshua: Case closed. Next time, ask where the data went and how often before you look at how big it was.

all_clues_monologue: That's enough. A job nobody remembers copied the customer table to an address nobody approved, 2 MB at a time, for eleven nights.
The big transfer of the night was the harmless one. Time to press REPORT and fill in what left, how and where.

entries.title: Spam to the address I gave only to you
entries.detail:
From: Priya Anand, Support
To: IT desk
Time: today 08:15

A customer, Mr. Okafor, got spam on the address he gave only to us. He wants to know who sold it. Other customers may have the same.
monologue: A private address that only we have, and now spam on it. Either he told someone else, or the list left the building.
Which one fits what I will find in the logs?
entries.summary: Priya's customer got spam at an address he gave only to us.

entries.title: Partner report, 08:00
entries.detail:
From: Tomas Ruiz, database admin
To: analytics partner
Time: today 08:00
Attachment: hourly_summary.csv (3 MB)

The hourly summary the partner asked for. It goes out every hour, from the web server.
monologue: Tomas sends a 3 MB summary to the analytics partner every hour. It is a data transfer, and it is on the list of things we agreed.
Data leaving is not the same as data leaking. Who approved this one?
entries.summary: Tomas sends a 3 MB summary to the analytics partner every hour, as agreed.

To: all staff
Time: Monday

The nightly backup runs at 01:00 and copies the servers to the backup cloud. You may notice the network is busy at that hour. That is normal.
monologue: The backup runs at 01:00 and everybody was told. A busy network at that hour is expected.
entries.summary: The nightly backup runs at 01:00 and everybody was told.

entries.title: Alert summary: db-01
entries.detail:
From: Alert system
To: IT desk
Time: today 07:00

The alerts flagged db-01 three times this week: an export at 03:10 each time. Nobody read them.
monologue: The alerts did their job. db-01 was flagged three times this week, and nobody read them.
An alert nobody reads is not much of a defense. What was it trying to say?
entries.summary: The alerts flagged db-01 three times this week. Nobody read them.

entries.title: Alert summary: nothing
entries.detail:
From: Alert system
To: IT desk
Time: today 07:00

No alert fired on db-01 this week.
monologue: No alert on db-01 all week. Quiet is what a careful thief aims for.
entries.summary: No alert fired on db-01 this week.
